limitations: One standard topic, one raw unencrypted SQS subscriber and one metric alarm in us-east-1. SetAlarmState exercises an actual alarm action, not a metric evaluator; no metric data is published.

Only CloudWatch receives service-principal KMS GenerateDataKey/Decrypt rights. Its grant is topic encryption-context bound, with no SNS service grant. This is a positive publication/context capture, not a negative KMS-principal authorization matrix.
CloudTrail management event-history availability is asynchronous; absence is bounded by recorded poll window. No changes to any standing trail or organization settings.

KMS identity accessKeyId values, when present, are replaced by stable category-prefixed SHA256 aliases; other userIdentity fields and complete encryption contexts are retained. CloudTrail lookups retain complete matching owned events plus all query inputs, page counts and continuation tokens, not unrelated account events.

findings.correlation: Unique owned CMK and topic, exact alarm ARN/account/reason nonce in raw SQS receipt, exact receipt equality with successful alarm action published default payload, KMS encryption-context topic ARN and event timestamps within triggering call to receipt interval. KMS records do not expose the SNS or SQS message ID.

import datetime, hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('testdata/aws/sns/encryption_cloudwatch_source.json')
s=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert s.get('finished_ms'), 'Capture must be complete'
assert not s.get('failure'), s.get('failure')
r=s['owned_resources']
observations={x['label']:x for x in s['observations']}
cleanup={x['label']:x for x in s['cleanup']}
receipts=[x for x in s['receipts'] if x['correlated']]
assert receipts, 'Expected actual native receipt'
findings=[]
for receipt in receipts:
    trigger=observations['set-alarm-'+receipt['round']]
    notification=receipt['decoded_notification']
    assert notification['NewStateReason']==trigger['input']['StateReason']
    assert notification['AlarmArn']==r['alarm']['arn']
    assert notification['AlarmActions']==[r['topic']]
    matched_history=[]
    history=observations['alarm-history-'+receipt['round']]['result']['output']['AlarmHistoryItems']
    for item in history:
        if item['HistoryItemType']!='Action': continue
        data=json.loads(item['HistoryData'])
        if data.get('actionState')!='Succeeded' or data.get('notificationResource')!=r['topic'] or not data.get('publishedMessage'): continue
        messages=json.loads(data['publishedMessage'])
        default=json.loads(messages['default'])
        if default==notification: matched_history.append({'timestamp':item['Timestamp'],'summary':item['HistorySummary'],'history_observation_label':'alarm-history-'+receipt['round']})
    assert matched_history, 'Receipt must exactly match successful alarm action published default payload'
    kms=[]
    for item in s['cloudtrail']['events']:
        event=item['event']; context=event.get('requestParameters',{}).get('encryptionContext',{})
        if event.get('errorCode') or event['eventName'] not in ['GenerateDataKey','Decrypt'] or context.get('aws:sns:topicArn')!=r['topic']: continue
        event_ms=int(datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(event['eventTime'].replace('Z','+00:00')).timestamp()*1000)
        assert trigger['request_started_ms']-1000 <= event_ms <= receipt['observed_ms']+1000, (event['eventTime'],trigger['request_started_ms'],receipt['observed_ms'])
        kms.append({'event_id':event['eventID'],'request_id':event['requestID'],'event_name':event['eventName'],'event_time':event['eventTime'],'encryption_context':context,'user_identity':event.get('userIdentity'),'source_ip_address':event.get('sourceIPAddress'),'user_agent':event.get('userAgent')})
    findings.append({'receipt_message_id':receipt['message']['MessageId'],'round':receipt['round'],'notification_alarm_arn':notification['AlarmArn'],'trigger_observation_label':trigger['label'],'successful_action_history_matches':matched_history,'successful_kms_events':kms,'correlation':'Unique owned CMK and topic, exact alarm ARN/account/reason nonce in raw SQS receipt, exact receipt equality with successful alarm action published default payload, KMS encryption-context topic ARN and event timestamps within triggering call to receipt interval. KMS records do not expose the SNS or SQS message ID.'})
assert cleanup['verify-alarm-absent']['result']['code']=='Success'
assert not cleanup['verify-alarm-absent']['result']['output']['MetricAlarms']
assert not cleanup['verify-alarm-absent']['result']['output']['CompositeAlarms']
assert cleanup['verify-subscription-absent']['result']['code']=='NotFound'
assert cleanup['verify-topic-absent']['result']['code']=='NotFound'
assert cleanup['verify-queue-absent']['result']['code']=='AWS.SimpleQueueService.NonExistentQueue'
key=cleanup['verify-key-pending-deletion']['result']['output']['KeyMetadata']
assert key['KeyState']=='PendingDeletion'
assert cleanup['schedule-key-deletion']['input']['PendingWindowInDays']==7
s['findings']=findings
s['cleanup_summary']={'alarm_absent':True,'subscription_absent':True,'topic_absent':True,'queue_absent':True,'key_id':key['KeyId'],'key_state':key['KeyState'],'deletion_date':key['DeletionDate'],'pending_window_days':7}
s['source_references'].append('https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Notify_Users_Alarm_Changes.html')
s['limitations'].append('KMS identity accessKeyId values, when present, are replaced by stable category-prefixed SHA256 aliases; other userIdentity fields and complete encryption contexts are retained. CloudTrail lookups retain complete matching owned events plus all query inputs, page counts and continuation tokens, not unrelated account events.')
s['setup_failures']=[{'label':x['label'],'result':x.get('result'),'transport_error':x.get('transport_error')} for x in s['observations'] if x.get('result',{}).get('code')!='Success']
s['analysis_source']={'filename':Path(__file__).name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'content':Path(__file__).read_text()}
p.write_text(json.dumps(s,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'findings':findings,'cleanup_summary':s['cleanup_summary'],'setup_failures':s['setup_failures']},indent=2))
